Research degrees (Master & PhD)
Embark on a journey into the exciting world of advanced physics research and academic discovery.
We offer an engaging and innovative environment for our research degree programs. Our academic community is renowned for its world-class research, and we provide opportunities for both Masters and PhD candidates to delve into cutting-edge physics and astronomy research. Whether you are passionate about particle physics, driven by discoveries in quantum technology, or fascinated by theoretical physics, we'll support you to cultivate your scientific curiosity and propel your academic career.
Research degrees
Master degrees
MSc Physics by Research
• One year MSc available in any research area
• 100% extended research project
Many students take this degree in order to get a taste of research without an initial commitment to a three-year PhD. However approximately 50 percent follow on with a PhD. MSc Physics by Research may also be taken by those qualified to BSc level who desire to progress to doctoral studies.
Although MSc Physics by Research is available in any research area we are also offering a one year MSc Physics by Research: Physics and the Climate.
MSc Physics by Research: Physics and the Climate
Use Met Officer datasets with Machine Learning (ML) algorithms (python), compare different datasets, look for evidence of climate change: compare ML methods with more conventional statistical methods, use ML to make predictions about climate data, use ML to learn more about UK climate and how it is evolving
Requirements:
• PH3040 (for Royal Holloway students)
• an interest in climate and atmospheric science
• an interest in computing
Please find more information on these courses and how to apply here.
PhD degrees
September 2026 entry
The Department of Physics held an online Postgraduate Open Event on 3 December 2025. A recording of the session can be viewed here.
• Applications for PhD degrees are made through our Applicant Portal.
• The first cohort of Particle Physics and Astronomy candidates will be invited for interview which are to be scheduled in February 2026.
• We accept applications until all available vacancies are filled.
• For Quantum Materials and Technology applicants, when submitting your application through our Applicant Portal, please email the supervisor named on your application. They will then contact you regarding availability of studentships and interviews.
• Note that tuition fees for overseas students are higher than students who qualify for home fees. We expect overseas candidates to either cover the difference in tuition fees themselves or qualify for an overseas fee waiver from the University. There are very few fee waivers available and competition is very high.
• Prospective applicants who would like to visit in person, please email.
Background
Typically, we accept 10 students annually onto PhD programmes in our research groups. Studentships are funded by UK Research Councils, the European Commission, the National Physical Laboratory (NPL), CERN, Diamond Light Source and Royal Holloway. We also have joint PhD studentships with our other research collaborations. We may also accept students who are self-funded or supported from other sources.
Projects
We use FindAPhD to advertise specific research projects that require PhD students and the current list is below. We welcome students with an interest to pursue a PhD in our research areas(condensed matter, particle physics, particle astrophysics, theoretical physics, astronomy, nanotechnology and quantum devices and accelerator physics). In this case please contact the relevant group contact on the research group pages or search the list of projects available below.
Applying to us
Applications for PhD degrees are via our Applicant Portal. Physics PhD candidates do not require a detailed research proposal. A short statement explaining your reasons for choosing the research area and relevant experience, a CV and relevant transcripts should be uploaded instead. Only make one application even if considering multiple projects.
Studentship opportunities
Many of our PhD offers are directly funded or competition funded. There are also other studentship opportunities listed here.
